line_format: one JSON object per line; an action that produces a result is prefixed 'rN = ' with N = (number of prior results of the demonstration) + (results produced earlier in this instruction) + 1; the instruction's action list ends with a blank line

fields.where: optional {KEY: value}; KEY = REL (SELF scope) | PARENT.REL | CHILD.REL

fields.rel: REL legal for the event type
fields.value: vocabulary value of the relation's class occurring in the instruction

fields.args: {parameter: vocabulary value occurring in the instruction | result of the parameter's type}

not_in_V1: FOR with a multi-step body (only 'each' over one action)
grammar_constraints: values are vocabulary items of the field's class that occur in the instruction (case-insensitive; 'H:00' -> 'H')
for inner event types (CALL EMAIL VISIT MESSAGE) the only time constraint is PARENT.WHEN; outer types (REMINDER PLAN REQUEST NOTE) use SELF.* or CHILD.<non-WHEN rel>
SELF relations must be legal for the event type (frozen ontology validity matrix)
references only to type-compatible prior results of the current demonstration
at most 4 actions per instruction; the action list may end only when every PERSON / TIME / PLACE value mentioned in the instruction is used
UNSUPPORTED / CLARIFY only as the first and only action
decoding: grammar-constrained beam search (beam 3). At each decision the frozen LLM scores every legal option string (each option ends with its JSON delimiter, so decisions split at natural token boundaries); scores are log P(option | prompt + text so far) renormalized over the legal options. The best complete action list is the raw LLM proposal.
post_checks: static validation (unknown results, value class / occurrence, CALL signature)
margin: best vs best DISTINCT complete action list >= MARGIN nats, else CLARIFY
to_steps: deterministic mapping to parent SEMVM_STEP_V1 ASTs (procedure/lang.py); FIND constraints in canonical order SELF < PARENT < CHILD then WHO WHEN WHERE RECIPIENT TOPIC; 'each' -> FOR $eK IN $x : <step>
